text:
incident-bot: ⚠️ INCIDENT: sudden p99 tail spike observed in router/ingress US-WEST-2 at 14:03 UTC. paging oncall. sources: streaming stalls + increased request latency (p95->600ms, p99->2.8s). no surge in 5xxs yet.

maria (oncall): Paging — I'm on it. Gathering quick context. Any customer tickets?

leo (support): A few users reported streaming stalls and reconnects in the last 10m, mostly EU customers routed via US-WEST-2 (weird). no error traces yet, just timeouts on websocket frames.

alex (sre-lead): Important: check routing table seed drift and LB affinity weights. Last rollout changed region-affinity weights 45m ago. Could be skewed hot partitions.

jin (runtime): Running quick query against metrics.
```bash
# p99 by region for /generate
curl -s "http://metrics.internal/api?m=router.p99&span=5m&group=region" | jq .
```

jin (runtime): results: US-WEST-2 p99=2.83s, EU-CENTRAL p99=320ms, US-EAST p99=210ms. throughput normal. Token generation tail is where latencies concentrate.

kai (router): I see a strong shard hotness on shard-122 and shard-123 in US-WEST-2, hotkey concentration from a handful of onboarding customers. routing-policy shows prefer_local=true + hashed weight bias.

maria (oncall): Any quick mitigations we can do to reduce tail? Can we reduce prefer_local weight or apply temporary evict on hot keys?

kai (router): Yes. We can reduce affinity weight for US-WEST-2 to force wider fanout. Patch takes ~20s to propagate. Patch command:
```json
{"routing_affinity_weight": 0.6, "seed": 0}
```

sara (prod-sre): Note: adjusting affinity will increase cross-region traffic, may raise egress costs but should lower per-request tail. Recommend rate-limit rollout to 10% -> 50% -> 100% for 5m checks.

alex (sre-lead): +1 on staged rollout. Maria, start 10% now, watch p99 and streaming error rates. If stalls reduce, proceed.

maria (oncall): Starting 10% affinity-weight reduction now. ops-bot, apply tag:router-affinity-rollout-10pct.

ops-bot: action: apply config "affinity-weight-reduce" to 10% cohort. rollout id: r-2026-03-15-1.

maria (oncall): Observing metrics — p95 improves marginally, p99 still elevated. streaming stalls reduced by ~20% in affected customers.

leo (support): Affected customer A (EU legal) opened a high-priority chat earlier; they're seeing fewer reconnects now but still intermittent stalls.

kai (router): Logs show lots of sticky-routing entries for shard-122 where kvcache miss rate is high -> causes extra hops and queuing. We'll try a targeted eviction of sticky entries for that shard.

jin (runtime): Eviction command queued. Note: eviction will flush prefix cache for those clients and may cause a short flurry of cold-starts.

maria (oncall): Proceed with eviction for shard-122 only. ops-bot, execute.

ops-bot: executing eviction: /control-plane/evict?shard=122&scope=sticky_entries -> started.

maria (oncall): Eviction done. Watch p99.

kai (router): Early signs: reduced queue length on shard-122, p95 down to ~230ms, p99 down to ~1.1s. Streaming stalls dropped ~55% for impacted sessions.

alex (sre-lead): Good. Still not at baseline. Two follow-ups: 1) why did affinity weight drift cause hotspot on shard-122? 2) why were EU sessions funneling through US-WEST-2?

jin (runtime): Investigating control-plane seeding logs. I see a recent seed-update job at 13:28 that rebalanced weights but failed to include zone affinity for eu nodes due to a parsing bug in the seed manifest (missing region tag). That's consistent with EU->US routing.

kai (router): That parsing bug is in routing-config-parser v1.4.3 introduced in last roll. We need a rollback planned: revert to v1.4.2 for the seed job.

maria (oncall): Rollback will take ~3-5m to propagate. Can we keep the eviction + affinity reduction while rolling back?

sara (prod-sre): Yes. Keep both mitigations. After rollback we should do a canary in EU region only to confirm routing seeds restored.

alex (sre-lead): Plan: 1) keep eviction live, 2) continue affinity staged rollout to 50% after 5m if p99 trending down, 3) rollback seed job to v1.4.2 (canary EU), 4) if stable, full rollback and close.

maria (oncall): Initiating rollback for seed job now for EU canary only. ops-bot, deploy seed-v1.4.2 to eu-canary.

ops-bot: deploying seed-v1.4.2 to eu-canary -> success (14:22 UTC).

maria (oncall): Early telemetry: EU routing p99 back to ~200-350ms for canary. Proceeding to expand rollback to all regions.

ops-bot: deploying seed-v1.4.2 global rollout -> started.

maria (oncall): p99 across US-WEST-2 trending down to ~420ms, streaming stalls near baseline. Starting staged affinity rollout to 50% now.

kai (router): After global seed rollback, we also should patch routing-config-parser to add a strict validation that fails CI if region tag missing. I'll open PR.

jin (runtime): Also scheduling a job to reshard hotkeys to avoid repeated hot partitions. Will run a low-traffic reshard of shard-122/123 overnight.

leo (support): Notifying impacted customers: sent interim status to Customer A and a summary to onboarding customers. No complaints of errors beyond stalls; update will be pushed that we applied mitigations and rollback.

alex (sre-lead): Good. Let's keep the incident open for monitoring. Next steps: postmortem owner? kai to own router-side fix, jin to own reshard and runtime follow-up, sara to own rollout/QA changes, alex to coordinate incident write-up.

kai (router): I can own router-side fix and PR. Will also add feature-flag to disable prefer_local default.

maria (oncall): Moving to watch stage. If p99 remains under 600ms for 30m and streaming stalls <10% above baseline, we'll close pager.

ops-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maria (oncall): Closing loop for now. Closing notes: root cause = seed manifest parsing bug in routing-config-parser v1.4.3 + prefer_local affinity exposing hot partitions -> misrouting hot traffic to US-WEST-2 causing tail queues and streaming stalls. Mitigations: affinity staged reduction, targeted sticky eviction, seed job rollback, planned reshard + parser validation. Postmortem owners assigned.

alex (sre-lead): Thanks team. Will schedule a 1hr scrub in 2 hours to flesh out timeline and customer impact.

leo (support): I'll compile list of affected customers + timestamps and attach to postmortem.

maria (oncall): Thanks all.

incident-bot: Incident r-5403219876 marked: mitigated -> monitoring.
